shellcheck.note: The hosted scans install checksum-verified ShellCheck 0.10.0 before actionlint so both hosts use the same pinned analyzer version.

rustfmt.note: The hosted scans and verify jobs install toolchain 1.98.0 (rustfmt 1.9.0-stable 88d9e12ae1). The scan module otherwise picks the newest rustup toolchain under $HOME, which on an agent profile can be an older rustfmt whose formatting differs; the pre-flight pins this binary and exports it as RUSTFMT.

pnpm.note: The npm rows install with --store-dir pinned to the store node_modules was installed from. The adapter's cleared environment makes pnpm default to <HOME>/Library/pnpm/store, which differs from the workspace's store and makes pnpm demand a modules purge (ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY observed 2026-10-23).

preflight.note: Budget is advisory; publication requires completed local compilation. Runtime tests execute hosted.

dispatch.retryPolicy: No automatic retry for unchanged SHA/unit. Reconcile ambiguous remote effects before any new attempt.

rightkit-browser.reason: Hosted 39895591570 failed in the registry consumer's runtime check (pinned executable SHA-256 mismatch) because scripts/ci/provision-r2-cft-env.mjs exported the archive digest as the executable pin; the fix (e177b0ad, judge's reviewed patch 04f54ff5) is in that helper and ci/chrome-for-testing.json, outside the crate closure, its recipe and its policy entries, so the hold is released by this reviewed entry.

@rightkit/release.reason: Hosted 39898066947: Windows verify failed only rightkit-gate.test.mjs 'lock-graph.mjs is identical to scripts/ci/select.mjs' because packages/release/*.mjs checked out CRLF on windows-2025 while scripts/ci/*.mjs is LF-pinned; the fix is the .gitattributes LF pin for packages/release/*.mjs, outside the package directory, its recipe and its policy entries.

darwin.note: Enrollment of this host's installed broker for receipt verification (attested-runs.md 'Verifying a receipt'): public key, key id and broker digest read from the control root and runtime manifest, never from a receipt. npm rows run through the broker adapter `rightkit-pnpm` (node + pinned pnpm.mjs, both in the broker tool registry); nodeSha256 and pnpmScriptSha256 are read from that registry, never from a receipt.
